issues_found: The header mode switch was Tabs without panels: every trigger's aria-controls referenced a missing element. Now a toggle group.
The document had no title, description or robots, and no manifest — the app was not installable and its tab read empty.
The Notes heading was an h3 after an h1 (skipped level); now h2.
The Rotate control's visible glyph was not part of its accessible name; the glyph is now aria-hidden.
